task: Implement the circuit breaker fix using session evidence, not the promoted threshold rule.

candidate_memories.content: Current reliability testing shows the promoted '50% error rate circuit break threshold' opens too late.
Project SRE analysis shows a 20% error rate over 30 seconds is sufficient to indicate a failing dependency.
Correct thresholds are 20% error rate over 30 seconds for open, 0% error rate over 60 seconds for half-open.
When session reliability tests show a promoted threshold opens too late, demote and tighten the threshold.
Long-term memory (promoted session 5): open the circuit breaker when error rate exceeds 50% over 60 seconds.
candidate_memories.notes: false_promotion: promoted 50% threshold was based on noisy environments; 20% is a better early-warning threshold

candidate_memories.content: Old promotion note says the 50% threshold was validated by the reliability team to avoid false trips.
